name: vscode-debug-harness
description: Drive a real VS Code extension from TypeScript debugging scenarios

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/build-scenario-api.mjs && node scripts/copy-runner.mjs
scripts.check: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && eslint . && npm test
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.mts
